# We're testing cache behavior, so start with a clean GKCACHE.
env GKCACHE=$WORK/cache

# Build something so that the cache gets populates
go build main.go

# Check that cache contains directories before running
exists $GKCACHE/00

# Run go clean -cache -n and ensure that directories weren't deleted
go clean -cache -n
exists $GKCACHE/00

# Re-run go clean cache without the -n flag go ensure that directories were properly removed
go clean -cache
! exists $GKCACHE/00

! go clean -cache .
stderr 'gecko: clean -cache cannot be used with package arguments'

# GKCACHE must be an absolute path.
env GKCACHE=.
! go clean -cache
stderr 'gecko: GKCACHE is not an absolute path'

-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello!")
}
